title: Depth after conversion to binary
statement: Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit tree and let $w$ be a nonnegative integer. If every gate of $c$ has fan-in at most $w$, then the depth of its binary conversion is at most $\mathrm{depth}(c)\bigl(\lceil\log_2 w\rceil+1\bigr)$, where the ceiling logarithm is the least integer $k$ such that $2^k\ge w$.
hypotheses_covered: The maximum fan-in of $c$ is at most $w$
